theme.name: Organic Intelligence
theme.description: A sophisticated blend of Swiss clarity and Organic warmth. It feels like a high-end botanical study room for the future.

heading.usage: Use for all H1-H3 headings to add human character to the AI experience. Tracking-tight.

body.usage: Use for UI text, labels, and long-form content. High legibility.

mono.usage: Use for data values, timers, and phonetic transcriptions.

dashboard_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4 p-4 md:p-6
dashboard_grid.rules: Primary metric = col-span-2. Feed = col-span-2 row-span-2. Use aspect-ratio to maintain shape.

marketing_hero.classes: flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center gap-12 py-20 px-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto
marketing_hero.rules: Text left (40%), Visual right (60%). Visual must break the grid or float.

voice_interface.classes: flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-[80vh] w-full relative overflow-hidden
voice_interface.rules: Centralize the visualizer. Transcript floats below. Controls fixed at bottom.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-soft
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-full px-6 py-4 font-medium
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent/10 hover:text-accent rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium

cards.base: bg-card text-card-foreground border border-border/50 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300

inputs.base: bg-input/20 border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-base transition-all placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50

textures.noise: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

voice_state.listening: Pulse animation on central orb. Scale 1.1 -> 1.0 infinite.
voice_state.speaking: Waveform amplitude modulation based on volume.

hero_main.alt: Diverse group of students discussing around a table
hero_main.usage: Landing page hero section, right side or background with overlay

tutoring_context.alt: Two women in an intimate tutoring setting

brand_texture_green.usage: Backgrounds for cards, auth screens, or subtle overlays

brand_texture_dark.usage: Dark mode backgrounds or 'Listening Mode' active state

workspace_setup.usage: Blog/Resources section or Dashboard empty state

accessibility_rules.contrast: Ensure text is APCA compliant. Use 'font-medium' on dark backgrounds.
accessibility_rules.voice_cues: MUST provide visual feedback for all voice states (Listening, Processing, Speaking) for deaf/hard-of-hearing users.
accessibility_rules.reduced_motion: Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion'. Disable parallax and heavy transitions.

iconography.usage: Use icons as visual anchors, not just decoration. Pair with text where possible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set up the Tailwind config with the custom colors defined in 'theme.colors' above.
Create a 'Layout' component that handles the Navbar (with Dark/Light toggle) and Footer.
Implement the 'VoiceVisualizer' component early - it's the core USP. Use the 'brand_texture' images as masks or backgrounds for it.
For the Dashboard, use the 'bento' grid strategy. Don't make generic rows.
Use 'Fraunces' font for all Headings. Import it from Google Fonts.
Ensure all buttons have the 'rounded-full' style to distinguish from the rectangular cards.
All interactive elements MUST have 'data-testid' attributes.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' - no generic gradients or centered text without purpose.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Do not apply universal transition 'transition: all'.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
